summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Operoo Staff UI - Phase 3 (Role-based UI). All 21 test features passed successfully. Admin and Staff users see different dashboards and sidebars based on role. Staff cannot access admin-only routes (redirected to /dashboard). Clock-in/out toggle works. Tasks page with tabs and status updates works. Calendar with week/list views and navigation works. Profile page with language selector works. Mobile responsive design works with hamburger menu.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is excellent - proper use of data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
Role-based routing implemented correctly with AdminRoute wrapper
Clock-in/out is MOCKED - uses React state only, no backend persistence
Tasks status changes are MOCKED - uses React state only, no backend persistence
Calendar events are MOCKED - uses static mock data from mockData.js
Profile save is MOCKED - shows confirmation but doesn't persist to backend
seed_data_creation: Staff user giulia@operoo.com was registered via /api/auth/register with role='staff'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 role-based UI testing complete. Admin sees admin dashboard with 6 nav items (Dashboard, Staff, Appointments, Clients, Marketing, Shop). Staff sees staff dashboard with 4 nav items (Dashboard, Tasks, Calendar, Profile). Staff cannot access admin routes - redirected to /dashboard. All staff features (clock-in/out, tasks, calendar, profile) use MOCK data with React state only.

admin_user: Admin sees Admin Dashboard (not Staff Dashboard)
Admin sidebar has 6 nav items (Dashboard, Staff, Appointments, Clients, Marketing, Shop)
Admin dashboard shows stats cards, quick actions, recent activity, staff overview
staff_user: Staff sees Staff Dashboard (not Admin Dashboard)
Staff sidebar has 4 nav items (Dashboard, Tasks, Calendar, Profile)

Clock-out button works - toggles back to 'Off Shift'
Task counts shown: Pending=4, In Progress=2, Completed=2

calendar_page: Calendar shows week view with shifts and appointments
Week label shows correct date range
profile_page: Profile shows user info (name, email, phone, department)
mobile_responsive: Hamburger menu button visible on mobile
Staff dashboard displays correctly on mobile
